items.title_en: Mumbai Indians Fans Share Photos As 19,000 Girls Attend KKR Match in Heartfelt Initiative
items.title_zh: 孟买印第安人队球迷在 19,000 名女孩观看 KKR 比赛时分享照片
items.summary_en: As the MI vs KKR match takes on with the #ESADay initiative, Twitter is buzzing with excitement as fans share photos and praise for the players, turning the platform into a sea of ‘blue’ enthusiasm!
items.summary_zh: 随着 MI 与 KKR 比赛在 #ESADay 活动中展开，Twitter 上沸腾了，粉丝们分享照片和对选手的赞扬，将平台变成了一片“蓝色”热情的海洋！
